message:

It needs to be retried once the storage issue is resolved."}

hold_reason: Incomplete refunds: order 172's 7535-cent refund failed on all three attempts with a disk I/O error, and list_refunds reportedly confirms it is missing. Resolve the storage issue and record the missing refund before processing payouts.
